name: Prof. Dr. Christian Bachmeir
headline: cloud, security, AI, DSGVO
summary:
Dr. Bachmeir is working in the aera of Internet of Things,  (Edge-)Cloud, PaaS, and distributed Cyber-Physical-Systems, with the target to improve processes or develop new products/services.

In this context he is working with clients on strategic questions.

Before he served on several leadership positions in the industry:
At IBM he lead strategic projects, was a Client Director for at that time the largest Client of IBM in Europe, with more than 200 mill. USD in revenue and a specialized delivery-team of more than 1.000 talented global colleagues,  was Sales Director for Security Services in the DACH region, an Associate Partner, and an Account Manager within Global Technology Services (GTS) for several large banking clients in Frankfurt.
His first Job in IBM was "Integrated Technology Services Manager", working on Client-Problems for several large banks in Frankfurt.
Before joining IBM he worked at Mercer as divisional CIO in Outsourcing, working on Development and Operations of an SAP-based platform.
His first professional tenure was with Accenture working as a Manager in Technology Consulting and Outsourcing within the Datacenter Technology & Operations Practice. The focus was on Operations, Implementation and Rollout of global SAP-Systems in the area of Procurement and Accounts Payable.
His first job in Accenture was Technical Architect for a large full stack BPO-Offering for a large global bank.
In this first assignment already, Christian worked globally at various client and Accenture offices, in India, London, Warwick, Barcelona, New York (downtown), and various other places. Usually at Accenture to prepare the team, then followed by a country-go-live at client site.
That kind of work, kind of continued 🤣

On his various assignments he gathered industry expertise in Aviation (primarily working for Lufthansa), Financial Services (working primarily for Allianz, Deutsche Bank, Commerzbank, Deutsche Bundesbank and European Central Bank), and Telecommunications (working for Deutsche Telekom) - all within the Infrastructure/Cloud/Security-domain.

Christian studied Electrical Engineering & Information Technology, and Management at Technische Universität München, at Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), and at the Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM).
